name: Shadra: her melee lands on a level 60 player
contract: She is level 60, the fixture players are level 60, and she is defensive so she does not aggro at spawn. A second player engages her; over twenty seconds the attacker's recorded melee damage taken must be well above zero. A near-zero value at equal level means her swings are being avoided and the cause is not the level gap.

steps.label: The attacker takes melee damage from her
The attacker is not at full health
